---
applyTo: "src/messages/**/*.json"
description: i18n catalog parity — keep en.json and pt.json key-symmetric.
---

These are next-intl message catalogs. Enforce
[`.ai/rules/stack.md`](../../.ai/rules/stack.md) i18n rules and the
[`i18n-a11y-steward`](../../.ai/agents/i18n-a11y-steward.md) charter: every key in
`en.json` MUST exist in `pt.json` with identical nesting, and vice versa. When you add,
remove, or rename a key in one file, make the same change in the other in the same edit.
`pt` must read as natural Brazilian Portuguese, not a literal gloss. Flag any orphan key.
